patches.title: Season 1

newWeapons.note: 5.56 assault rifle with the highest fire rate in its class, per the notes. Season 1 Battle Pass.
SMG the notes say can be dual-wielded akimbo. Season 1 Battle Pass.

weapons.flag: CODMunity's post-patch record also lowers the close-range headshot from 41 to 40. The notes don't list it. The site uses CODMunity's numbers.
The notes list Medium damage 1 as 15 → 15 but mark it 8% up. CODMunity's post-patch record shows 16, and the site uses that.

notes: The notes change damage, hit location multipliers, one bullet velocity and one ADS movement speed. They list no attachment changes.
Apex and shotgun damage changes are listed for reference. The optimizer has no model for Apex damage or shotgun pellets, so those rows do not move any score.
